note: Triennial election of the Newtownards (later North Down) rural district councillors, one for each of eighteen divisions; nominations received by Mr. John Warden, deputy returning officer, on 4 May 1927. Ballywalter was the only contest, polled Thursday 2 June 1927 and declared the next day; in Crawfordsburn, Groomsport, Portaferry and Quintin no nomination was received and the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. Both candidates were new; nominated as John A. Robb and David Ewart. No party labels printed. Majority computed (not printed).
